title: Privacy-scoped profile, project and application sharing
summary: Share canonical URLs through an accessible review dialog, anonymous metadata/images and recipient-qualified first-party cards. Count published public portfolio identities and canonical public skills. Reuse chat permissions and idempotency, retain failed drafts, and prevent old authorization or avatar snapshots from surviving privacy changes.
dataSourcesChanged: Project access and approved image asset references
Existing authorized/idempotent chat send and preview-hidden fields
concurrencyRisk: Preview queries are account/session scoped, aborted on cancellation and never persist first-party data; offline/refetching hides protected cards. Profile/project projection permissions are checked again after asynchronous summary work. Anonymous image reads recheck visibility after asset loading and PNG rendering, discarding changed/revoked snapshots. Sends verify the expected actor against the server session and recover existing receipts before resolving renamed links. One compose intent survives uncertain receipts, while conversation authority remains in the canonical SQL send function. Project references use stable ids while displaying readable canonical labels.

logs: Existing chat.action_failed and route rate-limit logs

rollback.strategy: Revert sharing code and menu/dialog integrations; retain existing schema and messages. No database migration or live fixture writes are required.
validation: Existing profile and chat flows still work
Anonymous metadata never includes restricted identity
Old first-party cache scopes are discarded

commands: npx playwright test -c tests/browser/playwright.config.ts sharing.spec.ts profile.spec.ts --project=chromium --project=webkit
